name: Cuuldurach the Glimmer King

facts.text: A level-80 dragon in the Sheeroe Hills; patch 1.61b gave him a weakness to heat.
Post-period campaign text: he terrorised Hibernia for decades, darkened Sheeroe's skies and ruled the Glimmer; his eggs and a rift in the Veil follow his death.
He bellows a warning from the skies to all who intrude, cannot be hurt outside his lair, and breathes at 90, 80 ... 10% health.
Adds come to him at 85/70/55/40/25/10% health, at most six in a fight; his glare picks real players.
He is 'he' in every script line ('glares at all of the creatures attacking him'). This bible keeps him male.
Players called him the only male of the three dragons (Allakhazam comment, May 2003); raiders held four entrances against his adds.

story:
Cuuldurach came through the Veil when Sheeroe opened, and he came as a king, not a beast. He keeps a king's manners: he warns before he kills, his voice rolling down from the clouds, and he names the trespasser before he crushes him. His court is the Glimmer, cold lights that may once have been sparks of the Veil itself, and his heir is Maldahar, who rides the ridges in his name.

The hills are sworn to him. Draw him out of his lair and no weapon in Hibernia will bite; that is not cowardice but law, the law of a land that will not let its king bleed on foreign ground. Inside the lair the law runs the other way. Every tenth part of his strength that falls, he answers with a breath of fire, and as the fight turns against him his courtiers come pouring in through the four doors to die at his feet. The old Hibernians who remember the green summers say the court is the true fight and the dragon only the crown on it. Since the druids found that heat hurts him, the realm's casters go up the pass smiling. They stop smiling at the first breath.
legend: Hold the four doors and he is only a dragon. Tanks on him inside the lair, never out of it; once he is past the edge of his court he is untouchable and you are only feeding him. Heal through the breath at every tenth. Heat hurts him, so the eldritch and the mana mentalists earn their keep. And when he glares at you, you are the one he means: spread out and do not stand where your friends stand.

aggro: Let all who intrude into my domain pay heed.
You stand in my court uninvited. I will remember your face.

phases.text: Come, my court. Your king has need of you.
The hills will not let you leave. Nor will I.
Light does not die. It only waits.

death: The hills seem to weep for the loss of their king.
slay: Your body will rest at my lair, little one.
One more light for my court.

lairEntry: The air hums. A king is near.
Four doors. The court is coming.

phases.text: The Glimmer pour through the four doors!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The Glimmer King has fallen. Sheeroe will heal.
atmosphere.wake: Cuuldurach rises. The sky over Sheeroe darkens.

loremasterTopic.text: Cuuldurach, king of the otherworld court that leaned into Sheeroe. Outside his lair the land itself shields him; inside it he breathes fire at every tenth wound and his court comes through four doors. Tell your raid leader about the doors before you go, not after.

bookPage: Of the King's Law, as the druids of Connacht teach it: a king may not be wounded on ground that is not his. So it is with Cuuldurach. Beyond the edge of his court the hills cover him like a cloak, and steel turns aside. Within it he is as mortal as any king, and like any king he calls his household when he is pressed. Count his wounds by tenths, for each tenth brings fire. Count his doors by fours, for each door brings the court. The druids add, more quietly, that heat is a sickness to light that came from the cold side of the Veil.

chronicle.win: {realm} held the four doors of Sheeroe, and {raidLeader}'s raid brought down the Glimmer King in {minutes} minutes. The hills wept.
chronicle.loss: {realm} went up to Sheeroe under {raidLeader}; after {minutes} minutes a door fell, and the Glimmer King's court did the rest.
